item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will cover the region. An intense winter monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on Friday. The weather will be cold in the morning over the region, and very cold over inland areas over the weekend. It will become fine and dry over southern China. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream early next week, temperatures will rise progressively and it will be relatively humid over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Dry with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 15 - 18 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
